summary: Apollo IG Core Replacement, L.P. filed a routine Form 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of limited partnership interests for approximately $3.0 million in cash on October 1, 2026, conducted under its continuous private offering pursuant to Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D and/or Regulation S. The filing also discloses an August 31, 2026 net asset value of $1,317.2 million (investments at fair value $1,318.1 million against $1,293.4 million cost, $58 thousand cash, $952 thousand liabilities). No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, advisor, premium, or deal terms are present; this is ordinary fund capital-raising and NAV disclosure.
